summary: Iteration 33: Manual Intelligence Uploads - Add to Feed Feature. All tests passed (14/14 backend, all frontend UI verified). New POST /api/add-to-feed endpoint works correctly with duplicate detection (409), user-provided titles, severity validation, and priority score clamping. Sidebar renamed to 'Manual Int Uploads', page title shows 'Manual Intelligence Uploads'. URL tab has both 'Analyze' and 'Add to Feed' buttons. Quick add form expands inline with all fields (Title, Severity, Priority, Threat, Region, Summary, Cross-Border). AddToFeedModal opens from analyzed URL cards with pre-filled AI analysis data. Added items appear in Intelligence Feed and Dashboard.
